name: Memory Recall Accuracy
description: Evaluates whether an AI agent correctly recalls facts established in earlier conversation turns, without confabulating information that was never stated. The full conversation history is embedded in the judge prompt — high token cost.

expectedInputs.description: The agent's response in the current turn.
IReadOnlyList<ConversationTurn> of prior turns. Read via ConversationHistoryHelper.TryGetHistory.
